mediaWork.title: Eyewitness Testimony: Civil and Criminal
mediaWork.creatorName: Elizabeth F. Loftus, James M. Doyle, Jennifer E. Dysart, Karen A. Newirth (latest edition)
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: The psychology of eyewitness testimony and its impact on legal proceedings, both civil and criminal
mediaWork.summaryNotes: This book examines the psychology of eyewitness testimony and its impact on legal proceedings. It uses scientific research to explain how and why eyewitness testimony can be unreliable, leading to wrongful convictions.  The book bridges psychological research and legal practice, offering practical guidance for legal professionals while explaining the scientific basis for concerns about eyewitness testimony. It has influenced legal reforms regarding the use of eyewitness testimony and is considered a foundational text in the field.
